stops.name: Jurapark Aargau
stops.detail: The Jurapark Aargau route leads through Switzerland's green treasure trove – across fields, past gnarled high-crowned trees, through the sparse forests of the Tafeljura and Kettenjura. In two stages, you cross unique cultivated landscapes and experience the Jurapark Aargau in all its diversity.
